heading: Share what you learned the hard way
lead: IceStack shouldn't depend on one person writing everything. If you've debugged it, operated it or regretted it in production, your experience belongs here.

realProblems.label: Real problems
realProblems.detail: The question you had to answer at work.

approaches.label: Different approaches
approaches.detail: The option a page didn't consider.

tradeoffs.label: Trade-offs
tradeoffs.detail: What it cost you that nobody mentioned.

examples.label: Implementation examples
examples.detail: The same pattern, in your stack.

mistakes.label: Common mistakes
mistakes.detail: The trap you fell into, so others don’t.

pick.title: Pick or propose a topic
pick.body: Check the open issues, or open one with the “New topic” form so nobody writes the same page twice.

copy.title: Copy the template
copy.body: One folder per topic. Add km.mdx for Khmer now or later; the site shows English until it exists.

write.title: Write it in plain Markdown
write.body: Use the template headings. Real numbers, real commands, and an honest “When Not To Use”.

preview.title: Preview, then open a pull request
preview.body: The page appears in navigation, search and the reasoning path automatically. A maintainer reviews it like code.

template.title: The template
template.body: Every page uses the same headings in the same order, so readers always know where to look and contributors never start from a blank page. Write the headings in English in both languages; the site shows them in Khmer to Khmer readers.
template.note: Patterns and trade-offs use the same headings and may skip ones that don't apply. Implementation pages are free-form.
template.lessonNote: Writing a course lesson instead? Lessons use their own six-step template: the problem, the idea, an example, try it, check yourself, key takeaways.

specific.title: Be specific
specific.body: Versions, numbers and the command you actually ran. “It’s faster” is not a finding; “p95 fell from 900 ms to 140 ms” is.

boring.title: Include the boring option
boring.body: Every Options section lists the simplest thing that could work, and doing nothing.

whenNot.title: Say when not to
whenNot.body: A recommendation without limits is marketing. “When Not To Use” is not optional.

safely.title: Share production lessons safely
safely.body: Real incidents make the best pages. Remove company names, customer data and secrets first.

noPitches.title: No vendor pitches
noPitches.body: Name a product when it matters to the decision, not to promote it.

smallCode.title: Keep the code small
smallCode.body: Implementation shows the smallest version that works. Link out for the full project.

translate.title: Khmer translations
translate.body: Translating a page is one of the most useful contributions. Keep the English technical terms (cache, retry, idempotency, index) and explain them in Khmer; readers will meet those words at work.
translate.draftNote: Mark a translation that has not been reviewed with translation: draft in the frontmatter. The page shows a notice and stays on this list until a reviewer removes it.
translate.allReviewed: Every page has a reviewed Khmer translation. Thank you!

preview.title: Preview locally
preview.body: Open http://localhost:3000. New pages appear in navigation and search as soon as you save the file.
